Once upon a time, in Brooklyn New York, an immigrant boy of thirteen started working in a pizza store after school. Lines and lines of customers came in to watch this young man's award-winning pizza tossing. The boy, champion pizza maker Eddie, loved making serve in the US Marine Corps during the Vietnam War. But pizza making was Eddie's passion. Upon returning home, he opened his first pizza store in Far Rockaway, NY, doing what he did best - making delicious pizza. That success was followed by another thriving pizza store on Ave. J in Brooklyn. Thereafter Eddie and his brother Ari, owned and operated the famous landmark pizza restaurant - Broadway's J-2 NYC Pizza - for over 25 years in NYC. It was one of the busiest and largest pizza restaurants in the whole world. Millions of these traditional cheesy, tasty NYC pies were being enjoyed by pizza lovers who truly appreciate quality pizza. Today, Eddie owns and operates the largest wholesale & retail handmade pizza parlor located in the Sunset Park area of Brooklyn. He's still doing what he loves the most - making the world's most delicious pizza. Only now they can be enjoyed anywhere. Eddie's legendary pizza pies are currently available across America & worldwide in the frozen food section of your local grocery store & supermarket. It's hard to resist dipping into Sabra Roasted Red Pepper Hummus. A little sweet and a little smoky, this hummus has just the right amount of zip. So dunk a carrot. Dip a chip. Heck, grab some celery, if you want. This 10-ounce tub is perfect for snacking, cooking and passing around the table. Sabra is the hummus that brings you back to the basics—eating with your hands, talking face to face and sharing your day. This delicious recipe blends roasted red peppers with chickpeas (also known as garbanzo beans) and creamy tahini for bold flavor. So pop off the lid at a backyard barbecue. Or serve it with veggies for gluten free snacks in the break room. Sabra hummus brings people together. This vegan dip is gluten free, kosher and Non-GMO Project Verified, so it's ideal for sharing. Sabra hummus and vegetable dip is made with chickpeas grown by family farmers in the Pacific Northwest and blended with ingredients from around the world. With Sabra Roasted Red Pepper Hummus, it’s all about doing what tastes good.

The Classic Hummus and Roasted Red Pepper Hummus are also available in 17-ounce, 30-ounce and 34-ounce tubs and convenient on-the-go singles. When you’re looking for a splash of lemon or lime juice, nothing beats ReaLemon and ReaLime. Made with 100% lemon and lime juice from concentrate, you get the benefit of the great taste of real juice without the hassle of cutting into fresh lemons or limes. First introduced in Chicago in 1934 by Irving Swartzburg, ReaLemon and ReaLime have been trusted brands that deliver only the highest quality of lemon and lime juice. ReaLemon and ReaLime are space-saving kitchen sidekicks, ideal for adding a delicious twist of lemon or lime to your favorite seafood and poultry recipes. Although they’re both great for use in a variety of marinades, they have their unique uses as well. Use ReaLemon to brighten up both hot and cold beverages or use ReaLime to add a bright splash of flavor to salads and dressings. When you want the real taste of real lemon or lime, simply reach for ReaLemon and ReaLime.

Nutritious and delicious, these non GMO, organic lentils have 12 grams of protein and 5 grams of fiber per serving, and they're good source of iron. To cook, sort and rinse 1 cup of lentils before placing them in 2 cups of cold water in a sauce pan. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and cook for 30 to 45 minutes. Red lentils have an earthy flavor that is delicious when added to rice pilaf, red lentil dahl, soups and stews. They also make a great meat alternative in sloppy joes and veggie burgers. For a crunchy, healthy snack, cook these organic red lentils and roast them with salt, olive oil and your choice of seasonings. This 16 oz bag of Arrowhead Mills Organic Red Lentils contains about 10 servings and is easy to store in the pantry.
